name: Charge Limit
author: k7cfo
description: When you plug in, choose 80% or 100%, then power-saver, balanced, or performance. Skip the card later from a checkbox; turn it back on from the bar.

barWidget.description: Shows the charge cap. Click for ask-on-plug. Right-click runs the cap-then-profile wizard.

schema.label: Battery-life cap (%)
schema.description: Where charging stops for everyday use. 80% is the usual laptop conservation stop. Start threshold is 5 points below, so the pack does not micro-cycle at the cap.

schema.label: Plug-in prompt timeout (seconds)
schema.description: If you ignore the prompt, the battery-life cap stays in place.

schema.label: Ask when plugging in
schema.description: Show the two-step card when AC connects: charge cap, then power profile. Uncheck to skip. Turn it back on from the bar panel.
